notes: Tipco Foods Public Company Limited (SET: TIPCO) — Thai diversified agribusiness, founded 1976. Core business is processed pineapple (canned/concentrate) and Tipco-brand fruit juices for Thai retail; also herbal supplements / plant-based protein expansion. Reports THB-millions Thai GAAP. Lists in THB on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. FY ends Dec 31. Smaller-cap (~THB 2bn revenue base) — earnings highly variable on pineapple supply (Thai harvest yields), shipping container availability, and juice consumer demand. FY24 swung to net loss on pineapple shortages + container availability; modest leverage profile.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue THB2.58bn (US$82M). COVID-driven juice volume support partially offset by foodservice channel weakness. Detailed EBITDA / balance-sheet line items not retrieved via English aggregators for this year.
FY21: Revenue THB2.43bn (-6%). EBITDA THB318M (margin 13.1%). NI THB429M — strongest year of period (associate gain contribution). DPS THB0.69.
FY22: Revenue THB2.90bn (+19%). Standalone EBITDA THB46M — heavily compressed by raw-material costs / impairment items. NI THB280M sustained by associate income. DPS THB0.77.
FY23: Revenue THB1.94bn (-33%) on pineapple supply shortage / weak juice exports. EBITDA THB120M (margin 6.2%). NI THB246M. DPS THB0.81 — peak payout supported by associate dividend.
FY24: Revenue THB2.06bn (+6%). EBITDA THB157M (margin 7.6%). Net loss THB(92)M — first annual loss in period; pineapple supply shortage + container availability + impairment. DPS held at THB0.73.
FY25 (preliminary): Revenue THB1.98bn (-3.77%). Total debt reduced to THB1.28bn; cash THB244M (net debt THB1.03bn). Detailed earnings pending publication.
